title: Bug 648938: Transfer Routes matrix does not indicate configured direct routes
summary: The Transfer Routes matrix now displays 'Direct' for configured direct-transfer routes without in-transit locations, instead of showing ellipsis that made them indistinguishable from undefined routes.
key_points: Direct-transfer routes in the In-Transit Code view display 'Direct' when configured without an in-transit location
Empty off-diagonal cells no longer obscure the presence of a configured direct route
Non-direct routes, undefined routes, diagonal cells, and shipping-agent views remain unchanged
Three new test procedures verify direct route display, precedence, and compatibility
Existing matrix baselines for in-transit code and shipping views still pass
quote: A configured off-diagonal direct route should display Direct, including when an in-transit code is also populated.
